Abstract: Despite the remarkable empirical success of flow-matching models, their statistical generalization guarantees remain underdeveloped. Existing analyses often impose restrictive assumptions on the estimated velocity field and yield convergence rates that fail to reflect the intrinsic low-dimensional structure common in real data, such as natural images and molecular geometries. In this work, we study the statistical generalization of flow-matching models for learning an unknown distribution $P_{\mathrm{data}}$ from finitely many samples. We derive finite-sample error bounds on the learned generative distribution, measured in the Wasserstein-$p$ distance, for all $p\geq 1$. Specifically, given $n$ i.i.d. samples from $P_{\mathrm{data}}$, we show that, for every $d>d_p^\ast(P_{\mathrm{data}})$ and appropriately chosen network architectures and hyperparameters, the learned distribution $\widehat{P}^{\mathrm{FM}}$ satisfies $ \mathbb{W}_p(\widehat{P}^{\mathrm{FM}},P_{\mathrm{data}}) \lesssim n^{-1/d}+n^{-1/(2p)}\bigl(\log(1/ξ)\bigr)^{1/(2p)}$ with probability at least $1-ξ$, where $d_p^\ast(P_{\mathrm{data}})$ denotes the Wasserstein-$p$ dimension of the target measure. Our results demonstrate that flow matching naturally adapts to the intrinsic geometry of data and mitigates the curse of dimensionality, as the convergence exponent depends on the intrinsic rather than ambient dimension. These guarantees remain meaningful in high-dimensional regimes and provide a theoretical explanation for the empirical success of flow matching on structured data distributions under substantially more relaxed assumptions than those in existing analyses.

</details>


### [296] [Hold-Out Scoring for Efficient Gaussian DAG Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02785)
*Donguk Shin,Byeongguk Kang,Inseol Lee,Gunwoong Park*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: HOST 是一种高效的 DAG 学习算法,用节点级留出评分与凸回归替代子集搜索,无需预设入度上界,在多项式时间内以 d log p 量级的样本复杂度精确恢复 DAG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维高斯 DAG 学习存在统计-计算鸿沟:高样本复杂度优势的方法依赖昂贵的子集搜索且需提供入度上界,而多项式时间方法样本复杂度较差。本文旨在弥合这一差距。

Method: 核心洞见是恢复正确排序不需要排序分数的一致小误差,只需单侧控制。排序步骤利用留出样本评分在期望上会膨胀排序分数,这对不应被选中的候选是有利方向;确定排序后,递归地从两节点间总效应中移除间接效应以恢复父节点。

Result: 在适当条件下,HOST 能在多项式时间内以 d log p 阶样本复杂度精确恢复最大入度为 d 的 p 节点 DAG;实验显示其图恢复效果具竞争力且运行时间伸缩性良好。

Conclusion: HOST 通过留出评分加凸回归,避免了子集搜索与入度上界依赖,以更优的样本复杂度实现高效精确 DAG 学习,兼顾统计与计算效率。

Abstract: High-dimensional Gaussian DAG learning faces a statistical-computational gap: methods with sharp sample complexity rely on computationally expensive subset search and a supplied indegree bound, whereas polynomial-time alternatives have less favorable sample complexity. We introduce HOST, an efficient DAG learning algorithm that replaces subset search with nodewise hold-out scoring and convex regression, without requiring a supplied indegree bound. Our key insight is that recovering a correct ordering does not require uniformly small estimation errors in ordering scores but only one-sided control of those errors. In the ordering step, HOST exploits the fact that score estimation using hold-out samples inflates ordering scores in expectation, which is the favorable direction for candidates that should not yet be selected. Given the ordering, HOST recovers parents by recursively removing indirect effects from total effects between two nodes. Under suitable conditions, HOST exactly recovers a $p$-node DAG of maximum indegree $d$ with sample complexity of order $d\log p$ in polynomial time. Experiments show that HOST achieves competitive graph recovery while exhibiting favorable runtime scaling.

</details>


### [297] [Invariance of Clustering Operations in Causal Effect Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03101)
*Jani Nykänen,Otto Tabell,Santtu Tikka,Juha Karvanen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究因果图变量聚类的可识别不变性问题，提出一类基于c-components条件的聚类操作，保证可识别性在聚类前后保持不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚类变量可缩小因果图、简化因果推断，但任意聚类可能改变关键因果关系并导致错误结论。已有结论只表明：聚类图可识别蕴含原图可识别；反之不成立（除非额外假设）。因此需要刻画在何种聚类下可识别性与不可识别性都被保留（即identification invariant）。

Method: 通过分析聚类操作与原图中c-components（c-分量）相关的条件，刻画并给出保证identification invariant的一大类聚类操作。

Result: 给出了一类广泛的、identification invariant的聚类操作，其条件与原始图的c-components相关。

Conclusion: 所提结果可用于实际场景，帮助在聚类简化因果图时避免改变因果可识别性。

Abstract: Clustering variables in causal graphs reduces the size of the graph and simplifies causal inference. However, arbitrary clustering can alter crucial causal relations among variables and lead to erroneous conclusions. While the identifiability of a causal effect in the clustered graph implies the identifiability in the original graph under mild conditions, nonidentifiability in clustered graph does not imply nonidentifiability in the original graph without further assumptions. When both identifiability and nonidentifiability are preserved, the clustering operation is called identification invariant. We present a broad class of clustering operations that are identification invariant based on conditions related to the c-components of the original graph. Finally, we demonstrate use of the results in practical settings.

</details>


### [298] [Predictively Oriented Gaussian Process Posteriors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03201)
*Callum Lau,Jeremias Knoblauch,Louis Sharrock*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出 Predictively Oriented Gaussian Processes (PrO-GPs)，将预测不确定性作为主要推断目标，在模型误设定下比标准GP提供更好的校准预测分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准高斯过程需要人工选择核函数与观测模型等设计决策，次优选择会导致模型误设定，无法捕捉真实数据生成过程。

Method: 将预测不确定性作为推断的核心目标；由于非参数模型中PrO后验的直接计算不可行，推导出简化公式与实用的采样方案以实现高效计算。

Result: 在合成数据与真实数据实验上，PrO-GPs 在模型误设定情形下产生比标准GP方法校准更好的预测分布。

Conclusion: PrO-GPs 为预测导向的不确定性量化提供了稳健的替代方案，应对GP的误设定问题。

Abstract: Gaussian Processes (GPs) are a powerful tool for modelling and quantifying uncertainty in functional relationships. However, they require practitioners to make a number of design decisions, such as the choice of the kernel and the observation model. Suboptimal choices can produce misspecified models that do not capture the underlying data generating process. We introduce Predictively Oriented Gaussian Processes (PrO-GPs), which treat predictive uncertainty as the primary inferential target and provide a robust alternative to standard GPs. Although direct computation of a PrO posterior for nonparametric models is intractable, we derive a reduced formulation and practical sampling scheme for efficient computation. Through synthetic and real data experiments, we show that PrO-GPs produce better calibrated predictive distributions under model misspecification compared to standard GP approaches.

</details>


### [299] [SDECast: Probabilistic Weather Forecasting in Continuous Time with Neural SDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03313)
*Maria Marchenko,Martin Andrae,Fredrik Lindsten,Christian A. Naesseth*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出SDECast，一种基于神经常微分/随机微分方程（SDE）的连续时间概率天气预报框架，通过SDE Matching在物理空间中直接学习随机动力学，无需训练时反复模拟SDE，实现全球逐小时分辨率、最长5天的有技巧概率预报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习天气预报模型通常在固定时间分辨率下通过自回归滚动生成预报。虽然长程预测高效，但在较短时间步下会遭遇严重误差累积，且未显式编码大气动力学的局部性与时间连续性。

Method: 提出SDECast，将SDE Matching扩展到物理空间中直接学习随机动力学，训练时无需重复进行SDE模拟，从而支持连续时间概率天气预报。

Result: 在模拟地球物理流上，SDECast能恢复有意义的漂移动力学并忠实再现潜在的连续时间行为；在全球天气预报中，可生成逐小时分辨率、长达5天的有技巧概率预报。

Conclusion: SDECast通过神经SDE框架实现了连续时间概率天气预报，兼顾局部性、时间连续性与可扩展性，为长时间跨度、细时间分辨率的天气预测提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Existing machine learning weather forecasting models typically generate forecasts through autoregressive rollouts at a fixed temporal resolution. While highly efficient for long-range prediction, this formulation can suffer from severe error accumulation when used with shorter time steps and does not explicitly encode the locality and temporal continuity of atmospheric dynamics. To address these limitations, we introduce **SDECast**, a Neural Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) framework for continuous-time probabilistic weather forecasting. SDECast extends SDE Matching to learn stochastic dynamics directly in physical space, without requiring repeated SDE simulation during training. On a simulated geophysical flow, we show that SDECast recovers meaningful drift dynamics and faithfully reproduces the underlying continuous-time behavior. We then demonstrate its scalability to global weather forecasting at hourly resolution, where SDECast produces skillful probabilistic forecasts for lead times of up to five days.

</details>


### [300] [DAWIS: Data Assimilation with Windowed Inverse Sampling via Multitask Interpolants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03314)
*Erik Wikingsson,Martin Andrae,Tomas Landelius,Fredrik Lindsten*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: DAWIS：基于多任务随机插值的统一数据同化框架，支持滤波、固定滞后平滑和块平滑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于流/扩散模型的滤波器只条件于固定历史并仅同化最新观测，无法在新观测到来时修正过去状态，估计被历史束缚，误差随时间累积。

Method: 用覆盖连续状态窗口的多任务随机插值替代状态级先验的单一流时间，为每个状态分配独立流时间。同化周期将窗口反演为逐状态的转向点向量，并在观测引导下重新生成，转向点控制每个状态被固定、修正或全新生成的强度。该构造还可将预测吸收进同化周期，免去单独的预测模型。

Result: 在具有挑战性的非线性系统上，DAWIS在稀疏、含噪、非线性观测下均优于滤波和平滑基线。

Conclusion: DAWIS统一了滤波与平滑，缓解了历史束缚和误差累积问题，代码已开源。

Abstract: Flow- and diffusion-based generative models have recently emerged as flexible and highly efficient forecasting models for dynamical systems. When combined with inference-time guidance, they offer a promising route to high-dimensional non-Gaussian data assimilation (DA), the problem of combining forecasts with observations to estimate latent system states. Existing filters, however, condition on a fixed history and assimilate only the most recent observation, leaving them unable to revise past states when new observations arrive. Estimates then stay tethered to a history that later observations may contradict, and errors accumulate over the assimilation run. To this end, we introduce **DAWIS**, a unified DA method covering filtering, fixed-lag smoothing, and block smoothing within a single framework. DAWIS replaces the single flow time of a state-level prior with a multitask stochastic interpolant over a window of consecutive states, assigning a separate flow time to each. An assimilation cycle inverts the window to a vector of per-state turning points and regenerates it under observation guidance, with the turning points controlling how strongly each state is held fixed, revised, or generated from scratch. The same construction can also absorb the forecast into the assimilation cycle, removing the need for a separate forecasting model. Experiments on challenging nonlinear systems show that DAWIS improves on both filtering and smoothing baselines under sparse, noisy, and nonlinear observations. The code for DAWIS is available at https://github.com/Erik-Wikingsson/DAWIS

</details>


### [301] [Iterating Consistency Models: Stability, Error Bounds and Noise Schedules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03414)
*Alessio Spagnoletti,Abdul-Lateef Haji-Ali,Andrés Almansa,Alain Oliviero Durmus,Eric Moulines,Marcelo Pereyra*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文为多步一致性模型（CMs）的采样提供了非渐近误差界理论，揭示调度策略在收缩初始化误差与控制近似误差积累中的不同作用，并给出可验证的稳定性假设与实用采样器设计指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步一致性模型虽在少步生成中表现优异，但增加步数对采样质量的影响高度依赖噪声调度，现有理论无法充分解释；需要精确的误差保证来指导采样器设计。

Method: 将多步CM采样建模为加噪算子与近似去噪算子的复合，在显式可验证的稳定性假设下推导非渐近误差界，分离初始化误差收缩与近似误差积累；并针对强对数凹与半对数凹目标给出显式常数，另建立基于单步精度与稳定性的互补保证。

Result: 误差界表明：早期大噪声水平驱动收缩，后期小噪声水平控制残差偏差；实验显示界中的收缩与近似曲线可可靠测量，且与预测的函数形式高度吻合。

Conclusion: 该工作为多步一致性模型提供了有意义的收敛理论，并为采样器设计给出了实用路径。

Abstract: Consistency models (CMs) have become a leading approach for generating high-quality samples in few steps. However, adding steps can improve or degrade sample quality in ways that are highly sensitive to the schedule and that existing theory does not fully explain. To provide accuracy guarantees and guide CM sampler design, we analyze multistep CM sampling as a composition of noising and approximate denoising operators. Under explicit, verifiable stability assumptions, we derive a non-asymptotic error bound that separates contraction of the initialization error from accumulation of approximation error. The bound assigns distinct roles to the schedule: large early noise levels drive contraction, while small late noise levels control the residual bias. As a corollary, we obtain explicit constants for strongly log-concave and semi-log-concave targets. We further establish a complementary guarantee whose assumptions, one-step accuracy and stability, can be estimated for a given trained model. Experiments show that the contraction and approximation profiles entering our bounds can be reliably measured and closely match the predicted functional forms. Together, these results provide a meaningful convergence theory for multi-step CMs and a practical route to sampler design.

</details>


### [302] [When Is Accuracy Evidence? A Unified Theory of Generalisation, Validation, and Information Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03465)
*JM Gorriz*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出γ-CUBV统一框架，用累积量包络控制泛化间隙，将K折CV扩展为涵盖多种依赖与异质源融合的风险上界，揭示折间依赖下有效折数Keff及小样本下CV不确定性增大现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: K折交叉验证常被当作样本外性能证据，但折之间既不独立，在异质数据下信息量也不均等，其均值精度缺乏严格风险保证。

Method: 以单一指数框架推广CUBV，用累积量包络γ(λ)控制泛化间隙的矩母函数；对K折CV用联合次高斯代理矩阵建模折间依赖，等相关下给出有效折数Keff=K/[1+(K-1)ρ]；并扩展到预测器后验分布与加权多源融合，权重通过最小化未来风险上界选取。

Result: 在异质多模态高斯混合上的线性分类器实验中，以覆盖率和紧致度评估边界；低维小样本下K折划分因单折欠represent少数模态而增大不确定性，修正的再代入法更有效且更紧，该效应随样本量增大消失。

Conclusion: γ-CUBV将观测性能、不确定性、依赖、模型复杂度与置信度显式分解为独立项，为从CV分数到风险陈述提供统一路径，并为神经影像等异质小样本应用给出有原则的验证准则。

Abstract: K-fold cross-validation (CV) is widely used as evidence of out-of-sample performance, although folds are neither independent experiments nor equally informative under heterogeneous data. Cross Upper-Bound Validation (CUBV) replaces point-wise CV accuracy by conservative upper bounds on true risk. Here we generalise CUBV through a single exponential framework in which the moment-generating function of the generalisation gap is controlled by a cumulant envelope gamma(lambda). This yields a family of risk bounds covering Hoeffding-, Bernstein-, dependency-aware, PAC-Bayesian, and heterogeneous source-fusion settings. For K-fold CV, dependence between fold-wise gaps is modelled through a joint sub-Gaussian proxy matrix. Under equicorrelation, this gives an effective number of folds, Keff = K/[1+(K-1)rho], showing that increasing K does not necessarily increase statistical evidence when folds are strongly dependent. The framework is also extended to posterior distributions over predictors and weighted multi-source fusion, where weights are selected by minimising an upper bound on future risk rather than empirical error alone. Experiments with trained linear classifiers on heterogeneous multimodal Gaussian mixtures compare K-fold CV with full-sample resubstitution plus risk correction. Bounds are evaluated by coverage and tightness. In low-dimensional small-sample settings, K-fold partitioning can increase uncertainty because individual folds under-represent minority modes, while corrected resubstitution can remain valid and tighter; this effect disappears as sample size increases. Overall, gamma-CUBV separates observed performance, uncertainty, dependence, model complexity, and confidence into explicit terms, providing a unified route from CV scores to risk statements and a principled validation criterion for heterogeneous small-sample applications such as neuroimaging.

</details>


### [303] [AREX: Affine-Residual Exponential Integrator for Few-Step Sampling in Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03483)
*Shizheng Lin,Soon Hoe Lim,N. Benjamin Erichson*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: AREX是一种免训练采样器，利用目标均值和协方差捕捉可解析的采样动态，通过矩阵传播子显式积分仿射分量，仅需对神经残差项积分，在少步采样中提升生成保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流匹配采样器（如标量指数积分器）只能解析处理各向同性线性动态，无法高效捕捉采样动态中的一般线性结构，导致少步采样时保真度受限，且需重新训练。

Method: 提出AREX，将学习到的速度场分解为：基于目标前两阶矩（均值与协方差）确定的仿射分量，以及神经残差项。证明矩匹配高斯目标的速度场是边缘速度场的L²最优仿射近似，用显式矩阵传播子积分仿射部分，仅对残差项做数值积分。免训练。

Result: 在图像生成和文本到图像生成任务上，AREX在少步采样场景下持续提升样本保真度，且无需重训练底层模型。

Conclusion: AREX通过解析提取流匹配动态中的仿射部分实现免训练加速采样，优于标量指数积分器，在少步采样中有效提升生成质量。

Abstract: We introduce AREX, a training-free sampler for pretrained flow matching models that uses the target mean and covariance to capture an analytically tractable part of the sampling dynamics. We show that the velocity field of the moment-matched Gaussian target is the $L^2$-optimal affine approximation to the marginal velocity field. This motivates decomposition of the learned dynamics into an affine component over the whole sampling path, determined by the first two target moments, and a neural residual term. AREX keeps the affine component and integrates it using an explicit matrix-valued propagator. In turn, we only require to integrate over the residual term. This differs from scalar exponential integrators, which analytically handle only isotropic linear dynamics. Across image and text-to-image generation tasks, AREX consistently improves sample fidelity in the few-step sampling regime without retraining the underlying model.

</details>


### [304] [Amortized Structured Stochastic Variational Inference for Gaussian Process Latent Variable Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03647)
*Maksym Tretiakov,Sarah Lucie Filipp,Vincent Fortuin,Ruth Misener,Ruby Sedgwick,James Odgers*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文通过Amortized Structured Stochastic Variational Inference改进GPLVM，使隐变量后验条件依赖于诱导点，从而更灵活地估计流形的不确定性并提升重建指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多机器学习方法试图逼近数据所在的低维流形，并希望捕捉所学流形的认知不确定性。GPLVM能提供这种不确定性估计，但其效果受限于GP诱导点与隐变量之间的mean-field变分近似。

Method: 应用Amortized Structured Stochastic Variational Inference，使隐空间的变分后验可以条件依赖于诱导点的取值，从而突破mean-field近似假设。

Result: 更灵活的变分后验在多项与数据流形上点重建相关的指标上表现更优。

Conclusion: 通过放松mean-field假设并引入结构化变分推断，可改善GPLVM的不确定性估计与重建效果。

Abstract: Many machine learning methods aim to approximate the lower-dimensional manifold on which the data lives. A desirable feature of such methods is that they should capture the epistemic uncertainty of this learned manifold. One model that achieves this is the Gaussian Process Latent Variable Model, in which a Gaussian Process (GP) mapping from the latent space provides an estimate of the uncertainty of the manifold. However, the effectiveness of this uncertainty estimation is limited by the mean-field variational approximation between the GP inducing points and the latent variables. In this work, we apply Amortized Structured Stochastic Variational Inference to allow the variational posterior for the latent space to be conditionally dependent on the value of the inducing points. We demonstrate that this more flexible variational posterior improves several metrics relating to the reconstruction of points on the data manifold.

</details>


<div id='math.OC'></div>

# math.OC [[Back]](#toc)

### [305] [The geometry of monarch matrix approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02226)
*Shintaro Yoshizawa*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文将Helmke-Shayman关于秩-r矩阵流形最小二乘距离的Morse理论推广到Monarch矩阵（固定置换矩阵与两个块对角因子之积），用转移矩阵不变量刻画规范维数与Bruhat型胞腔的余维/闭包关系，证明Monarch-Schur定理与Morse指标公式，并用四次正则化恢复梯度流的全局收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Helmke与Shayman已证明对泛型目标，秩-r矩阵流形的最小二乘距离是非退化Morse函数，其指标由Bruhat胞腔余维决定。作者希望将这一几何/优化理论推广到更结构化的Monarch矩阵族（置换矩阵与两个块对角因子之积），以理解这类因子分解层在最小二乘意义下的几何与优化性质。

Method: 作者将Monarch矩阵视为参数化流形，研究其规范维数、Bruhat型胞腔的余维与闭包关系，并引入共同的转移矩阵（transfer-matrix）不变量来统一刻画这些量，同时指出它们一般并不相等。在等块情形下证明Monarch-Schur定理，刻画最小化规范自由度和最大化流形维数的置换；对任意分块给出一般下界。进一步证明泛型二阶非退化性，推导Morse指标公式，并给出显式的零测焦集。针对无正则化梯度流缺乏强制性（因存在无界平坦方向），引入四次正则化。

Result: 建立了Monarch矩阵的Morse理论：规范维数与Bruhat型胞腔余维/闭包关系由转移矩阵不变量决定（二者一般不同）；证明等块情形下的Monarch-Schur定理及任意分块的一般维数下界；得到泛型二阶非退化性、Morse指标公式与显式零测焦集。证明无正则化梯度流因无界平坦方向而不具强制性；四次正则化恢复全局收敛，当存在时选出规范的最小范数精确解，否则给出定义良好的最佳逼近像，同时保持Monarch结构，并为结构化因子分解层中的权重衰减提供几何解释。

Conclusion: 该工作将Morse理论从秩-r矩阵推广到Monarch矩阵，用转移矩阵不变量统一刻画规范自由度与胞腔几何，并通过Monarch-Schur定理和Morse指标公式给出结构性质。四次正则化不仅修复了梯度流的非强制性，还给出了权重衰减在结构化因子分解层中的几何意义。

Abstract: Helmke and Shayman showed that, for generic targets, least-squares distance to the manifold of rank-r matrices is a nondegenerate Morse function whose indices are governed by Bruhat-cell codimensions. We develop the analogous theory for Monarch matrices, products of a fixed permutation matrix with two block-diagonal factors. The parametrization's gauge dimension, as well as the codimensions and closure relations of the associated Bruhat-type cells, is determined by a common transfer-matrix invariant, although these quantities are generally distinct. In the equal-block case, we prove the Monarch-Schur theorem, characterizing the permutations that minimize gauge freedom and maximize manifold dimension, and derive a general lower bound for arbitrary partitions. We further establish generic second-order nondegeneracy, a Morse-index formula, and an explicit focal set of measure zero. Finally, we show that the unregularized gradient flow lacks coercivity because of unbounded flat directions. A quartic regularizer restores global convergence, selects a canonical minimum-norm exact solution when one exists, and otherwise yields a well-defined best-approximation image. The regularizer preserves the Monarch architecture and provides a geometric interpretation of weight decay in structured factorized layers.

</details>


### [306] [Accelerated Safe Gradient Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02433)
*Xuting Gao,Sonia Martínez*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出加速安全梯度流（A-SGF），将二阶加速流通过二阶控制障碍函数二次规划滤波，在强凸约束优化中实现安全且保持Nesterov加速收敛速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在强凸约束优化中，既要保证约束满足（安全性），又要保留加速收敛。已有安全梯度流多基于一阶方法，缺乏对二阶加速流的安全修正及其收敛性保证。

Method: 用二阶控制障碍函数（CBF）构造二次规划，对名义二阶加速流进行滤波得到A-SGF。建立严格可行性与向量场局部Lipschitz连续条件，证明提升安全集的前向不变性，并说明唯一平衡点即约束最小值。采用变分Lyapunov分析推导障碍增益条件。

Result: 证明了前向不变性与平衡点最优性，并给出使A-SGF保持与无约束Nesterov加速法相同收敛速率的障碍增益显式条件；二维非线性算例展示了任意时刻可行性与更快收敛。

Conclusion: A-SGF能够在满足约束安全性的同时保持加速收敛，为强凸约束优化提供了具有理论保证的加速安全流方法。

Abstract: This letter introduces an accelerated safe gradient flow (A-SGF) for
  strongly convex constrained optimization problems. The A-SGF filters
  a nominal second-order accelerated flow through a second-order
  control barrier function quadratic program. We establish conditions
  for strict feasibility and local Lipschitz continuity of the
  resulting vector field, prove forward invariance of a lifted safe
  set, and show that its unique equilibrium is the constrained
  minimizer. A variational Lyapunov analysis isolates the effect of
  the safety correction and gives explicit conditions on the barrier
  gains under which A-SGF retains the same convergence rate as the
  unconstrained Nesterov accelerated method. A nonlinear 2D example
  demonstrate anytime feasibility and faster convergence of the
  algorithm.

</details>


### [307] [Fully Coupled Nonlinear Mean-Field FBSΔEs: Solvability and an LQ Buffer-Adjustment Illustration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02467)
*Yingjie Zheng,Qingxin Meng,Maoning Tang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文为带无条件一阶矩依赖的全耦合非线性均值场前向-后向随机差分方程建立有限时域可解性的充分条件，用支配-单调性方法给出唯一平方可积适应解、先验界与系数稳定性，并通过非线性算例、标量均值场LQ模型和有限场景树计算验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全耦合非线性均值场FBSDE的有限时域可解性条件尚不清晰，尤其当方程依赖无条件一阶矩、且前向递推含条件投影项时，需要构造不依赖系数小的充分条件。

Method: 在支配-单调性框架下，于中心坐标与均值坐标中构造确定性矩阵组合；证明关于同伦参数一致的延拓估计；利用全局Lipschitz连续与一个活跃的支配-强制性方向；活跃参数可归一化，用符号变换处理相反单调方向。

Result: 得到唯一平方可积适应解、先验界与系数稳定性，无需对原系数施加额外小性限制；饱和状态与均值交互的非线性例子验证假设，允许退化支配方向；标量均值场LQ缓冲调整模型的Hamiltonian刻画唯一开环最优解，精确有限场景树计算与直接二次优化一致。

Conclusion: 支配-单调性方法可推广至含无条件一阶矩依赖的全耦合非线性均值场随机差分方程，给出可验证的可解性判据和最优控制应用。

Abstract: This paper establishes sufficient conditions for finite-horizon solvability of fully coupled nonlinear mean-field forward--backward stochastic difference equations with dependence on unconditional first moments. The forward recursion uses conditional projections of the next backward state and its product with the innovation. Building on existing domination--monotonicity methods, we formulate deterministic matrix combinations in centered and mean coordinates and prove a continuation estimate uniform in the homotopy parameter. Global Lipschitz continuity and one active domination--coercivity direction yield a unique square-integrable adapted solution, an a priori bound, and coefficient stability. The active parameter can be normalized without imposing an additional smallness restriction on the original coefficients. A sign transformation handles the opposite monotonicity orientation. A nonlinear example with saturating state and mean interactions verifies the assumptions, including degenerate domination directions. A scalar mean-field LQ buffer-adjustment model illustrates the theorem: its Hamiltonian solution characterizes the unique open-loop optimizer. An exact finite scenario-tree calculation checks this characterization against direct quadratic optimization.

</details>


### [308] [Mean-variance portfolio selection: connections between mean-field systems and forward-backward stochastic systems under initial-terminal cost coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02485)
*Xun Li,Hongyu Shi,Zhen Wu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究均值-方差投资组合问题中均值场系统与前向-后向随机系统的联系，建立带运行成本及初终端耦合的随机最大值原理，并求解广义随机LQ问题的最优反馈表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 均值-方差投资组合选择中，均值场项可通过终端财富的条件期望过程表示为后向状态，从而产生一类具有初终端值耦合的前向-后向随机控制问题。但成本泛函中前向状态终端值与后向状态初始值的耦合，使经典前向-后向随机最优控制方法无法直接应用。

Method: 引入终端财富的条件期望过程将均值场项表示为后向状态，构建初终端值耦合的前向-后向随机系统控制问题；建立带运行成本与初终端耦合值的随机最大值原理并给出最优性充分条件；研究允许控制权重不定的广义随机线性二次（LQ）控制问题，通过Riccati方程导出最优反馈表示。

Result: 得到带初终端耦合的随机最大值原理及最优性充分条件；给出广义随机LQ问题的最优反馈表示；证明经典均值-方差投资组合模型为特例，并显式求出有效投资策略与有效前沿；通过数值模拟验证结果并分析参数敏感性及其金融含义。

Conclusion: 该工作打通了均值场系统与前向-后向随机系统在均值-方差投资组合中的联系，所建立的随机最大值原理和Riccati反馈方法有效处理了初终端耦合带来的困难，为相关随机控制问题提供了新的理论工具。

Abstract: This paper investigates the connection between mean-field systems and forward-backward stochastic systems arising from the mean-variance portfolio selection problem. By introducing the conditional expectation process of terminal wealth, the mean-field term is represented by a backward state, leading to a class of control problems for forward-backward stochastic systems with coupled initial-terminal values. The coupling between the terminal value of the forward state and the initial value of the backward state in the cost functional prevents classical methods for forward-backward stochastic optimal control from being directly applicable. To overcome this difficulty, we establish a stochastic maximum principle for control problems with running costs and coupled initial-terminal values, and provide sufficient conditions for optimality. Furthermore, we investigate a class of generalized stochastic linear-quadratic control problems with initial-terminal coupling, allowing the control weight in the running cost to be indefinite, and derive the optimal feedback representation via a Riccati equation. The classical mean-variance portfolio selection model is shown to be a special case, for which the corresponding efficient investment strategy and efficient frontier are obtained explicitly, and numerical simulations are presented to illustrate the results and examine parameter sensitivity and its financial implications.

</details>


### [309] [Recursive Stochastic Linear-Quadratic Control with Indefinite Weights for Jump-Diffusion Systems with Random Coefficients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02530)
*Xinyu Ma,Yang Liu,Qingxin Meng*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究带有限活动跳扩散、有界随机系数、不定权重和线性递归代价的有限时间随机LQ控制问题，通过测度变换与配方法，在变换测度下刻画随机Riccati方程并给出反馈表示、比较与唯一性结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典LQ控制多针对Brownian噪声且权重正定，而实际中常出现跳跃、不定权重及递归（BSDE）代价，现有结果难以直接覆盖。本文旨在将LQ理论推广至有限活动跳扩散与递归代价共存、且权重可能不定的情形。

Method: 采用Brownian-Poisson测度变换与积分因子，把递归LQ泛函化为非递归LQ泛函；在物理与变换平方可积控制空间交上建立L^1二次数据的递归求值与完全变换值等式；借助变换一致凸性与无控制跳映射可逆性，从非递归值核识别随机Riccati方程；用条件能量估计把鞅系数转移到物理测度；通过配方法得到反馈表示。

Result: 在变换一致凸性与无控制跳映射可逆条件下，得到了随机Riccati方程的识别及其在物理测度下的正确性，给出反馈表示、比较定理和反馈可容许类中的唯一性；并证明对每个初始对，递归值恰在变换最优控制具有有限物理控制能量时达到。解析算例展示了非零反馈和带负控制权重的一致凸性。

Conclusion: 该工作为跳扩散与递归代价下的不定LQ控制提供了统一框架，将递归问题约化为可处理的非递归问题，并明确了最优控制存在的能量条件，拓展了随机LQ理论。

Abstract: We study finite-horizon stochastic linear-quadratic (LQ) control for finite-activity jump diffusions with bounded random coefficients, indefinite weights and a linear recursive cost. The cost is defined by a backward stochastic differential equation (BSDE) whose generator has bounded deterministic coefficients multiplying the Brownian and jump integrands. A Brownian-Poisson change of measure and an integrating factor reduce the criterion to a nonrecursive LQ functional. On the intersection of the physical and transformed square-integrable control spaces, we establish recursive evaluation for L^1 quadratic data under the transformed measure and equality with the full transformed value. Under transformed uniform convexity and invertibility of the uncontrolled jump map, we identify the stochastic Riccati equation from the nonrecursive value kernel. Conditional energy estimates justify transferring its martingale coefficients to the physical measure. Completion of squares gives feedback representation, comparison and uniqueness in the feedback-admissible class. For each initial pair, the recursive value is attained exactly when the transformed optimizer has finite physical control energy. Analytical examples illustrate nonzero feedback and uniform convexity with a negative control weight.

</details>


### [310] [Second-Order Mean-Field Schrödinger Bridges with Partial State Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02537)
*Asmaa Eldesoukey,Md Zulfiqur Haider,Italo Napolitano,Yongxin Chen,Abhishek Halder*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了惯性多智能体系统的部分规格薛定谔桥问题，在平均场框架下仅给定端点位置分布，推导了最优性系统并设计了嵌套不动点算法求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 控制系统中决策常仅基于状态的局部信息，因此需要研究在仅有部分信息（仅端点位置分布，速度未指定）情形下的薛定谔桥问题。

Method: 在平均场框架下，将集体动力学刻画为带非局部相互作用的非线性Vlasov-Fokker-Planck积分-偏微分方程；仅指定时间端点上的位置分布，推导最优性系统，得到通过前向与后向传播共同确定的最优受控演化，并发展嵌套不动点算法（扩展Fortet-Sinkhorn迭代）处理非局部相互作用与时间耦合引起的非线性。

Result: 推导出相应的最优性系统，识别出最优受控演化由初末规格通过时间前向和后向传播共同确定；证明部分端点规格对最优控制与一致演化带来独特条件；开发了嵌套不动点算法来求解该最优性系统。

Conclusion: 该工作为部分信息下的惯性多智能体薛定谔桥提供了理论刻画与计算算法，拓展了经典薛定谔桥与Fortet-Sinkhorn方法至含非局部相互作用的平均场情形。

Abstract: Motivated by scenarios in control systems where decision making is informed by only partial information about the states, we introduce a novel formulation of the Schrödinger bridge problem for inertial interacting-agent systems. Within our setting, the agent ensemble is steered to match partial specifications of the collective configuration. Our analysis pertains to a mean-field framework in which the collective dynamics are described by a nonlinear Vlasov--Fokker--Planck integro-PDE with nonlocal interactions. We assume that only distributions over positions are specified at the endpoints of a finite time horizon, representing aggregate population snapshots, while the corresponding velocity degrees of freedom remain unspecified. We derive the associated optimality system, identifying the optimal controlled evolution as jointly informed by the initial and terminal specifications through forward and backward propagation in time. We also show that the partial endpoint specifications bring about distinct conditions on the optimal control and the consistent evolution. Subsequently, to compute solutions to the optimality system, we develop a nested fixed-point algorithm inspired by the classical Fortet--Sinkhorn iteration, but extended to handle the nonlinearities arising from nonlocal interactions and temporal coupling.

</details>


### [311] [Control of Markov Jump Linear Systems with Uncertain Lumpable Cluster Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02573)
*Carlos A. F. Persiani,Ram Padmanabhan,Melkior Ornik,Marco H. Terra*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究马尔可夫跳变线性系统在真实模态仅属于某观测簇（不精确已知）时的鲁棒控制，将问题建模为min-max最优控制并化归为Riccati递推求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统马尔可夫跳变线性系统控制假设系统活跃模态完全已知，但在实际中真实模态往往无法精确观测，仅能确认其属于某个模态簇。这导致系统动态和转移概率均存在不确定性，需要鲁棒的调节方法。

Method: 假设真实模态仅知属于一个可观测的模态簇，据此构建针对系统动态与转移概率双重不确定性的min-max最优控制问题，目标是鲁棒调节。借助正则化最小均方优化（regularized least mean-square optimization）的结果，将问题解耦并化归为一个Riccati递推，使控制器仅依赖于模态所属簇的信息。

Result: 证明了Riccati递推的收敛性以及所得闭环系统的稳定性，并通过数值算例验证了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法在模态信息不精确（仅知所属簇）情形下，实现了马尔可夫跳变线性系统的鲁棒调节，控制器结构简单（仅依赖簇信息）且具有收敛性与稳定性保证。

Abstract: In this paper, we consider the control of Markov jump linear systems when the active system mode is not exactly known. We rather assume that this true mode is only known to belong to an observed cluster of modes, making both the dynamics and the associated transition probabilities uncertain. We construct a min-max optimal control problem in this setting, with the objective of robust regulation. Using results in regularized least mean-square optimization, we describe how the solution of this problem can be reduced to a Riccati recursion, such that the controller depends only on knowledge of which cluster the mode lies in. We subsequently establish convergence of the recursion and stability of the resulting closed-loop system. A numerical example illustrates the effectiveness of the proposed methodology.

</details>


### [312] [Static Output Feedback Control for Multi-Agent Systems Using Nash Equilibrium](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02589)
*Paul Serna-Torre,Patricia Hidalgo-Gonzalez*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出一种基于半定规划(SDP)的静态输出反馈控制方法，用于网络化线性时不变多智能体系统，并证明其可扩展到IEEE 24节点电网的实际应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为多智能体系统设计静态输出反馈控制器具有挑战性，且既有研究多在小型数值模型上验证，缺乏对实际大规模网络化系统的可扩展性与实用性验证。

Method: 构建SDP模型合成静态输出反馈控制；理论上证明输出反馈控制可由状态反馈的Nash均衡构造，该均衡下智能体在系统动力学约束下最小化各自代价函数；并提供Python和MATLAB开源工具箱。

Result: 所提控制保证闭环稳定性及存在扰动时的耗散性；三个数值案例验证了成本效益与时域性能优于现有方法；第四个案例在261状态的非线性电网电磁暂态模型上设计了逆变器分布式频率调节控制器，仅使用邻居部分状态信息。

Conclusion: 该SDP框架具备良好可扩展性与实际应用价值，适用于真实网络化多智能体系统，并通过开源工具箱便于推广使用。

Abstract: This work proposes a semidefinite programming (SDP) model that synthesizes static output control feedback for networked linear time-invariant multi-agent systems (MAS). We theoretically prove that the output feedback control of MAS can be constructed using the Nash equilibrium previously derived for state-feedback control. The Nash equilibrium considers that agents seek to minimize their individual cost functions subject to the system dynamics of the MAS. The resulting control from the pro- posed SDP model ensures the stability of the closed-loop system and dissipativity when a disturbance is present in the MAS. A set of four case studies is implemented. The first three numerical cases serve to validate and compare cost effectiveness and time-domain performance of the proposed control framework with other state-of-the-art frameworks. The fourth case designs a frequency regulation scheme for a modified IEEE 24-bus power grid. Using the proposed framework, distributed controllers are synthesized for the inverters which are considered agents in the grid. Each inverter uses partial state information of the neighboring inverters. The resulting control scheme is implemented in a high-fidelity non-linear model of 261 states that describes the electromagnetic transient dynamics of the power grid. Hence, compared to prior studies that usually validate their frameworks in small-scale numerical models, this fourth case demonstrates a virtue of our pro- posed SDP: its scalability and practical utility in real-world networked MAS. We implement the proposed framework in an open-access toolbox in Python and MATLAB, enabling practitioners and researchers to readily implement it in their applications.

</details>


### [313] [Data-Driven Static Output-Feedback Control for Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02623)
*Paul Serna-Torre,Adam Sedlak,Patricia Hidalgo-Gonzalez*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出数据驱动框架，为线性时不变多智能体系统综合输出反馈控制，并在非线性电网中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动控制方法通常需要较强的可控性假设、在线信息与状态估计，且多在小规模数值仿真中验证，难以反映真实系统表现。

Method: 先用离线状态与输入轨迹数据设计两种算法求解多智能体系统的纳什均衡（NE）；再基于NE解构建半定规划，计算各智能体的静态输出反馈控制器。

Result: 在含构网型和跟网型逆变器的非线性多节点电网中实现电压与频率调节，成功稳定电网并提供调节服务；相比PI控制超调减少最高78%，调节时间加快30%。

Conclusion: 该框架弱化了可控性假设，无需在线信息和状态估计，并在高保真非线性MAS中验证有效，优于传统控制策略。

Abstract: This work proposes a data-driven framework that synthesizes output-feedback control for linear time-invariant multi-agent systems (MAS). We first develop two algorithms that use offline data samples of state and input trajectories to determine a Nash equilibrium (NE) for MAS. Next, we formulate a semidefinite program that, given the NE solution, computes the static output-feedback controllers for the agents in MAS. Compared to prior work, virtues of our framework include weaker controllability assumptions, the absence of online information and data-driven estimation of states. Next, we use the proposed framework to design control schemes for voltage and frequency regulation for nonlinear multi-nodal electrical networks with grid-forming and grid-following inverters. Thus, compared to prior work that implements their data-driven frameworks in small-scale numerical examples, we validate the performance of our data-driven framework in high-fidelity nonlinear models of MAS. This implementation in realistic MAS provides insights that small-scale numerical examples may fail to capture. Results show successful grid stabilization and provision of regulation services from the inverters in the grid using our proposed framework. It can attain up to 78% less overshoot and 30% faster settling time than traditional strategies such as proportional-integral control.

</details>


### [314] [A hybrid CNN-adjoint optimization framework for reconstruction of viscoelastic tissue properties in magnetic resonance elastography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02634)
*Anwesa Dey,Johann Rudi,Elena Cherkaev*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究MRE中复值剪切模量反演的严重病态问题，结合伴随优化与CNN，提出混合重建框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MRE通过剪切波传播量化软组织粘弹性，但从位移场恢复复值剪切模量是严重病态反问题，尤其在噪声和有限边界激励下困难。

Method: 基于修正静态Stokes系统的标量形式建立正问题，证明适定性、极小元存在性与一阶最优性条件，实现带Armijo线搜索的非线性共轭梯度法；构建2D CNN从复值位移映射到空间变化复剪切模量，并用CNN结果初始化伴随优化形成混合方法。

Result: CNN在单独扰动场上训练，能泛化到未见过的组合构型；混合方法相比单独优化收敛更快、精度更高，PDE约束优化进一步精化重建系数。

Conclusion: 将数据驱动初始化与基于物理的优化结合，可实现高效准确的MRE重建，展示该混合框架的潜力。

Abstract: Magnetic resonance elastography (MRE) is a noninvasive imaging modality for quantifying the viscoelastic properties of soft tissues from shear wave propagation. Recovering the complex-valued shear modulus from measured displacement fields leads to a severely ill-posed inverse problem, particularly in the presence of noise and limited boundary excitations. We investigate adjoint-based optimization, convolutional neural network (CNN) reconstruction, and a hybrid framework combining both approaches. The forward model is based on a scalar form of the modified stationary Stokes system with a complex shear modulus. We establish well-posedness of the forward problem, existence of minimizers, and first-order optimality conditions for the adjoint-based formulation, and implement a nonlinear conjugate-gradient method with Armijo line search. While PDE-constrained optimization can accurately refine coefficient reconstructions, its performance depends strongly on initialization. We therefore construct a two-dimensional CNN that maps complex-valued displacement measurements to spatially varying complex shear modulus fields and provides rapid, informative initial reconstructions. The proposed hybrid method uses the CNN reconstruction to initialize the adjoint-based optimization, yielding faster convergence and improved accuracy. The CNN is trained on coefficient fields containing individual perturbations and tested on both individual and previously unseen combined configurations. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the CNN generalizes to these more challenging configurations, while subsequent PDE-constrained optimization further refines the reconstructed coefficient. These results demonstrate the potential of combining data-driven initialization with physics-based optimization for efficient and accurate MRE reconstruction.

</details>


### [315] [Advances in Continuous-Time Multiparametric Optimal Control: The Role of Time-Varying Active Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02680)
*Lida Lamakani,Efstratios N. Pistikopoulos*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出在计算前即可判定多参数最优控制中临界区域边界形状（超平面或曲线）的方法，并归纳为五条规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多参数最优控制中相邻临界区域的边界可能是超平面或曲线，曲线边界必须计算，代价高；若能在计算前预判边界形状，可显著简化求解。

Method: 通过分析两个相邻区域的时变活跃约束序列，提出边界为超平面的两个条件：(1) 新约束在边界每一点同时变为活跃；(2) 其他约束的持续活跃时间在边界每一点相同。否则边界为曲线。由此得到五条判定规则。

Result: 在新颖的Newell-Lee蒸发器案例上验证规则，将七区域划分的八条边界分类为四条闭式超平面和四条精确计算的曲线边界。

Conclusion: 边界形状可由活跃约束序列在计算前直接判定，为多参数最优控制的区域划分提供了一种高效的结构性分析工具。

Abstract: Multiparametric optimal control in continuous time partitions the space of initial states into critical regions, each with its own control law involving a set of time-varying active constraints. The boundaries between two neighbouring regions are either hyperplanes, which are given in closed form by one linear equation, or curved boundaries, which must be computed. The sequence of time-varying active constraints plays a key role in defining the linear or nonlinear shape of a critical-region boundary. In this paper we show how to determine that shape prior to any computation. In particular, we show that the boundary is a hyperplane under two conditions. First, the new constraint becomes active at the same instant at every point of the boundary. Second, the durations for which the other constraints stay active are the same at every point of the boundary. Otherwise, the boundary is curved. Both conditions can be read from the sequences of active constraints of the two neighbouring regions, which gives five rules, each yielding a hyperplane or a curved boundary. We illustrate the rules on the Newell-Lee evaporator, where they classify the eight boundaries of a seven-region partition into four hyperplanes, given in closed form, and four curved boundaries, computed exactly.

</details>


### [316] [Finding Stationary Points under Higher-Order Smoothness: Trapping Algorithms and First-Order Lower Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02791)
*Huanjian Zhou,Masashi Sugiyama,Taiji Suzuki*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究高阶光滑下求近似驻点的查询复杂度，涵盖函数值/梯度两种oracle、不同维度与约束。提出"陷阱或下降"框架及高阶线积分技术，给出上下界匹配或接近的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在仅用函数值或仅用梯度、高阶光滑条件下寻找近似驻点的查询复杂度，并区分维度、oracle模型、随机性与约束条件，突破确定性梯度方法的既有barrier。

Method: 对常数维采用确定性函数值梯度陷阱算法及高阶线积分实现梯度陷阱；二维C^{1,1}用随机积分；一般维提出懒惰复用边界模型的"陷阱或下降"框架；并结合随机下界证明。

Result: 常数维d得确定性复杂度O(ε^{-(d-1)})（R^d）和O(ε^{-(d-1)/ν})（[0,1]^d）；二维C^{1,1}随机梯度查询O(ε^{-4/3})，打破Θ(ε^{-2})barrier；一般维函数值O(d^p+d^{p-1+β_p/(ν-1)}ε^{-ν/(ν-1)})、梯度O(d^{p-1}+d^{p-2+β_p/(ν-1)}ε^{-ν/(ν-1)})；高维随机下界Ω(ε^{-(3/2+1/(2p))})，无C^{1,1}时为Ω(ε^{-5/3})。

Conclusion: 结果在高阶光滑近似驻点查询复杂度上给出接近最优的上下界，精度指数与经典AR^p一致，并明确随机梯度方法在高维下的极限。

Abstract: We study the query complexity of finding approximate stationary points under higher-order smoothness using only function values or only gradients. Our results cover different dimensions, oracle models, randomization, and constraints.
  For constant dimension $d$ and $C^{p,β_p}$ objectives, with $ν:=p+β_p$, we give deterministic function-value gradient trapping algorithms with query complexities $O(\varepsilon^{-(d-1)})$ on $\mathbb R^d$ and $O(\varepsilon^{-(d-1)/ν})$ on $[0,1]^d$. High-order line integration enables gradient-only trapping. For two-dimensional $C^{1,1}$ objectives, randomized integration yields $O(\varepsilon^{-4/3})$ gradient queries on $\mathbb R^2$, breaking the deterministic gradient-only $Θ(\varepsilon^{-2})$ barrier.
  For general dimension, we introduce a trapping-or-descent framework that lazily reuses boundary models. For $C^{p,β_p}$ objectives with $p\ge2$, it achieves deterministic query complexities $O(d^p+d^{p-1+β_p/(ν-1)} \varepsilon^{-ν/(ν-1)})$ using function values and $O(d^{p-1}+d^{p-2+β_p/(ν-1)} \varepsilon^{-ν/(ν-1)})$ using gradients. These bounds apply to approximate stationary points on $\mathbb R^d$ and approximate KKT points on $[0,1]^d$. Their dimension-independent accuracy exponent matches the classical AR$p$ exponent $(p+1)/p$ when $β_p=1$.
  For sufficiently high dimension, we prove randomized lower bounds for gradient-only methods. For $C^{1,1}\cap C^{p,1}$ objectives, our lower bound is $Ω(\varepsilon^{-(3/2+1/(2p))})$, matching known upper bounds for $p=2$ and, up to logarithmic factors, for $p=3$. Without the $C^{1,1}$ assumption, we obtain an $Ω(\varepsilon^{-5/3})$ lower bound for every fixed $p\ge3$.

</details>


### [317] [When Can an Infinite-Stream Evaluation Support Dynamic Programming? Compatibility, Recursive Compression, and Generalized Summation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02842)
*Yingzhe Xu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究非标准无穷时域准则的动态规划。对绝对可和加权准则，证明精确连续自治延续状态的最小欧氏维数等于时间Hankel秩；Candelpergher–Ramanujan求和甚至更早失败，Abel求和对比如前缀闭合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非标准无穷时域准则下，动态规划不能仅靠有限流值：需保证一步控制替换仍可求值，并使延续信息递归传播。作者要厘清域可容许性、有限维连续自治可实现性、标量充分性与上下文序一致性之间的关系。

Method: 将期望阶段奖励流分解为四个条件：域可容许、有限维连续自治可实现、标量充分、上下文序一致。对绝对可和加权准则引入时间Hankel秩，并证明精确连续自治延续状态的最小欧氏维数等于该秩；下界对非线性连续编码器成立，且在单状态MDP中已成立。另比较字面意义Candelpergher–Ramanujan求和与Abel求和。

Result: 有限Hankel秩恰刻画了时间非平稳性可被有限内生状态增广替代的情形；该下界对非线性连续编码器仍成立且单状态MDP中即出现。字面Candelpergher–Ramanujan求和的共同延续测试更早失败：仅改变当前动作就可能离开求值域。Abel求和提供前缀闭合的对照基准。

Conclusion: 非标准无穷时域动态规划的可实现性由Hankel秩精确决定；不同求和法在以延续状态替代时间非平稳性方面能力不同，Candelpergher–Ramanujan求和比Abel求和更脆弱。

Abstract: Dynamic programming for nonstandard infinite-horizon criteria requires more than finite stream values: one-step control substitutions must remain evaluable, and continuation information must propagate recursively. For expected stage-reward streams, we separate domain admissibility, finite-dimensional continuous autonomous realizability, scalar sufficiency, and contextual order consistency. For absolutely summable weighted criteria, we prove that the minimum Euclidean dimension of an exact continuous autonomous continuation state equals the temporal Hankel rank. Thus finite Hankel rank exactly characterizes when temporal nonstationarity can be replaced by finite endogenous state augmentation; the lower bound applies even to nonlinear continuous encoders and already holds in a one-state MDP. For literal Candelpergher Ramanujan summation, the same common-continuation test fails earlier: changing only the current action can leave the evaluation domain. Abel summation provides a contrasting prefix-closed benchmark.

</details>


### [318] [Quantitative Mean-Field Limits for Recent Variants of Consensus-Based Optimization Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02901)
*Konstantin Haug*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本论文为三种CBO变体（δ-CBO、共识冻结CF、共识跳跃CH）严格推导了混沌传播结果，证明当粒子数N→∞时经验测度收敛到相应平均场方程解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于共识的优化（CBO）能求解高维非凸/非光滑全局优化问题，已有多个新变体但缺乏严格的平均场极限理论保证，需要证明粒子系统在大粒子极限下忠实逼近理想平均场动力学。

Method: 采用耦合方法推导混沌传播估计；对三种变体分别在两种情形下分析：一是经验测度一致有界的高概率集上，二是无限制情形下利用矩界和对粒子间依赖性的细致处理实现无条件收敛。

Result: 对δ-CBO、CF、CH三种方案均建立了当N→∞时相互作用粒子系统的经验测度收敛到对应平均场方程解的结果，得到定量化的混沌传播估计。

Conclusion: 论文为三种CBO变体提供了定量混沌传播估计，证明粒子系统在大粒子极限下忠实逼近理想平均场动力学。

Abstract: Consensus-based optimization (CBO) is a robust and flexible zero-order, multi-particle class of methods devised to provide provable solutions to high-dimensional global optimization problems, including truly nonconvex and/or nonsmooth cases. The algorithmic framework is grounded in a principled trade-off between stochastic exploration of the search space and deterministic contraction toward a consensus point. This thesis is concerned with three recently established variants of CBO. The $δ$-CBO method is similar to the classic CBO method, with the difference that the diffusion function is constant. The consensus freezing (CF) scheme can be understood as a piecewise CBO method. The overall time horizon is divided into intervals in which the consensus point is fixed. The consensus hopping (CH) scheme can be understood as a deterministic iterative scheme that jumps at each iteration to a Gaussian distribution centered at the consensus point of the previous distribution. The central contribution of this thesis is the rigorous derivation of propagation of chaos results for all three schemes. For each variant, we establish that the empirical measure of the interacting particle system converges, as the number of particles $N$ approaches infinity, to the solution of the corresponding mean-field equation. Two regimes are treated: first, on a high-probability set on which the empirical measures are uniformly bounded; second, in the unrestricted setting, where moment bounds and a careful treatment of the inter-particle dependence yield convergence without imposing conditioning on favorable events. The propagation of chaos estimates are derived by the coupling method. Together, these results provide quantitative propagation of chaos estimates for all three CBO variants and establish that the particle systems faithfully approximate the idealized mean-field dynamics in the large-particle limit.

</details>


### [319] [An Adaptive Symplectic Proximal Point Algorithm: Faster Convergence and Improved Numerical Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02963)
*Yi Zhang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究自适应辛普列克邻近点算法（ASPPA），证明其在平方范数项上具有O(1/k²)收敛率，且在强单调包含问题下具有指数收敛率，数值实验表现良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 邻近点算法（PPA）是求解单调包含问题的基本方法，多种凸优化算法可视为其特例。尽管已有加速变体，但某些情况下PPA收敛速度反而快于加速PPA，因此需要研究自适应加速版本的PPA。

Method: 提出自适应辛普列克邻近点算法（ASPPA），即辛普列克加速PPA的自适应版本。

Result: 证明ASPPA关于平方范数项的收敛率为O(1/k²)，与部分加速PPA相同；在求解强单调包含问题时具有指数收敛率；数值实验显示性能良好。

Conclusion: ASPPA在理论上达到加速收敛率并具备强单调情形下的指数收敛，且实验性能优异，是一种有效的PPA加速方案。

Abstract: The proximal point algorithm (PPA) stands as a fundamental approach for solving monotone inclusion problems. Notably, several key convex optimization algorithms have been proven to be specific instances of PPA. Given the importance of the PPA, there has been growing interest in developing its accelerated variants. However, for some specific cases, the PPA converges faster than the accelerated PPAs. In this paper, we mainly study an adaptive version of symplectic accelerated PPA, called adaptive symplectic proximal point algorithm (ASPPA). We first prove that the convergence rate of ASPPA with respect to the square norm term is $O(1/k^2)$, which is the same as the convergence rate of some accelerated PPAs. Also, we show that ASPPA exists exponential convergence rate when solving strongly monotone inclusion problem. Our numerical experiments indicate that the performance of ASPPA is very good.

</details>


### [320] [System Level Synthesis for Fast Chance-Constrained Post-Fault Ascent Replanning under Persistent Propulsion Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02989)
*Dai Shen,Chen Yang,Lin Cheng,Hongbo Zhang,Hongtao Zheng,Shengping Gong*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种快速机会约束随机上升轨迹重规划方法，显式处理持续推力不确定性，通过系统级综合与Cholesky变换高效设计反馈控制器，降低修正需求并保证约束满足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非致命推力故障会使标称上升轨迹失效，但车辆仍有能力到达原轨道或降级目标。确定性重规划可恢复标称可行性，然而已辨识推力能力中的残余不确定性仍可能导致路径约束违反和终端入轨散布，因此需要显式考虑持续推力不确定性的随机重规划方法。

Method: 构建结合跨预测时域持续随机不确定性与逐区间独立扰动的模型；对固定标称轨迹使用系统级综合参数化闭环响应；通过基于Cholesky的系统响应变换，将跨时间相关的反馈设计转化为共享Riccati递推的逐列仿射递推；基于无相位修正赤道元素推导面向任务的最小能量入轨后修正终端权重，将终端协方差整形与修正需求关联；通过交替确定性轨迹重规划与反馈控制器设计求解，并以协方差机会约束回退耦合两者。

Result: 非线性蒙特卡洛仿真表明，该方法在不同不确定性水平和故障条件下降低了等效修正需求，有效满足机会约束，并实现快速在线重规划。

Conclusion: 所提快速机会约束随机上升轨迹重规划器能够显式处理持续推力不确定性，兼顾约束满足、终端协方差整形与在线计算效率。

Abstract: A nonfatal propulsion fault can invalidate the nominal ascent trajectory while leaving sufficient vehicle capability to reach the original orbit or a degraded target. Deterministic replanning can restore nominal feasibility, but residual uncertainty in the identified propulsion capability may still lead to path-constraint violations and terminal injection dispersion. This paper develops a fast chance-constrained stochastic ascent trajectory replanner that explicitly accounts for persistent propulsion uncertainty. The uncertainty model combines persistent random uncertainties shared across the prediction horizon with interval-wise independent disturbances. For a fixed nominal trajectory, system level synthesis is used to parameterize the closed-loop responses. A Cholesky-based transformation of the system responses converts the resulting cross-time correlated feedback design problem into column-wise affine recursions that share a common Riccati recursion. A task-oriented terminal weight is further derived from the minimum-energy post-injection orbital correction in phase-free modified equinoctial elements, thereby relating terminal covariance shaping directly to correction demand. The stochastic replanning problem is solved by alternating deterministic trajectory replanning and feedback controller design, with covariance-based chance-constraint backoffs coupling the two updates. Nonlinear Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate reduced equivalent correction demand, effective chance-constraint satisfaction, and fast online replanning over a range of uncertainty levels and fault conditions.

</details>


### [321] [Forward-Backward McKean-Vlasov System with Jumps and a Monotone Source With à Control-Shifted Interface : Well-Posedness, Stability, and Yosida Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03041)
*Kayembe Tshiswaka Tcheick,Mabela Matendo Rostin,Kabengele Mpunga Yannick,Bosonga Bofeki Jean Pierre*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究带跳前向-后向McKean-Vlasov系统（单向耦合），其中极大单调算子沿前向状态取值，控制量移动其最小范数选择的间断界面；建立模型式适定性与强稳定性，并分析Yosida逼近的收敛及显式速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带有沿前向状态取值的极大单调算子源、且控制量移动间断界面的前向-后向McKean-Vlasov系统（含跳）此前缺乏系统的适定性与逼近分析，尤其缺少对Yosida逼近在状态、律与控制（移动界面）同时变动下的收敛性及定量速率研究。

Method: 考虑单向耦合的前向-后向McKean-Vlasov系统（含跳）；前向方程独立于后向变量，BSDE依赖前向状态及其律。源由极大单调算子（凸势次微分，状态经控制函数平移，并含律依赖项）给出。建立模型式适定性、对模型族一致估计的强稳定性，并研究Yosida逼近：强收敛、Minty型强-弱闭性（状态、律、控制变动时）及积分条件下的—致收敛。对非对称损失厌恶原型，用界面附近薄层的定量占位估计得到显式Yosida收敛速率。

Result: 证明了模型式适定性与强稳定性且估计对模型族一致；Yosida逼近具强收敛、Minty型强-弱闭性及积分条件下的—致收敛。对非对称损失厌恶原型，界面附近薄层的占位估计给出显式Yosida收敛速率；当连续鞅部分非退化且界面绝对连续移动时，占位时间与层宽线性相关，该速率同时控制后向分量与累积源。

Conclusion: 该工作为含跳、单向耦合且界面受控移动的前向-后向McKean-Vlasov系统建立了适定性与稳定性框架，并给出Yosida逼近的收敛性及显式速率，体现了界面占位时间与层宽的线性关系在收敛速率中的核心作用。

Abstract: We study a forward-backward McKean-Vlasov system with jumps and one-way coupling: the forward equation is independent of the backward variables, whereas the BSDE depends on the forward state and its law. A source generated by a maximal monotone operator is evaluated along the forward state and then accumulated in the backward equation. The operator is the subdifferential of a convex potential evaluated at the state translated by a function of the control, plus a term depending on the law of the state, so the control shifts the discontinuity interface of its minimal-norm selection. We establish modelwise well-posedness and strong stability, with estimates uniform over the model family. We then study the Yosida approximation: strong convergence, Minty-type strong-weak closedness when the state, its law, and the control (hence the moving interface) vary, and uniform convergence under an integrability condition. For an asymmetric loss-aversion prototype, a quantitative occupation estimate for a layer around the interface yields an explicit Yosida convergence rate. When the continuous martingale part is nondegenerate and the interface moves absolutely continuously, the occupation time is linear in the layer width. The same rate controls the backward components and the cumulative source.

</details>


### [322] [A Counterexample to the Exact Eight-Point Angular-Energy Conjecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03207)
*Jinze Zhao*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 该文给出精确反例，推翻Mouchet 2005年提出、2006年发表的八点角能量猜想：猜想声称全局最大值及边长单位、间距h₀=√(1+2√2)/2的正方形反棱柱构型；作者证明同一族在有理间距489/500处有更大的角度和。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mouchet的八点角能量猜想既指定了全局最大值的可能取值，又指定了达到该值的最优构型（特定间距的正方形反棱柱）。作者希望检验该猜想的精确性，并构造严格反例。

Method: 将正方形反棱柱族中全部168个角余弦之和化简为一元函数，对其导数进行因式分解，并用有理不等式证明导数符号；同时精确刻画该族内唯一的最大化间距。

Result: 证明在间距489/500处该族的角度和严格大于猜想给出的h₀=√(1+2√2)/2处的值；所有用于反例的比较均为精确比较。

Conclusion: 该结果以精确方式否定了Mouchet猜想所陈述的精确形式。

Abstract: We give an exact counterexample to the eight-point angular-energy conjecture stated by Mouchet in 2005 and published in 2006. The conjecture specifies both a radical value for the global maximum and a square antiprism with unit-side horizontal squares separated by $h_0=\sqrt{1+2\sqrt{2}}/2$. We prove that the same family at the rational separation $489/500$ has a strictly larger angular sum. The proof reduces the sum of all $168$ angle cosines to a one-variable formula, factors its derivative, and certifies its sign using rational inequalities. We also characterize the unique maximizing separation within this family. All comparisons needed for the counterexample are exact. The result disproves the exact stated conjecture.

</details>


### [323] [Near-Optimal Convex Optimization with Lazy Second-Order Oracles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03222)
*Xinliang Zhang,Lesi Chen,Chengchang Liu,Jingzhao Zhang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究"懒惰二阶"凸优化预言机模型，给出迭代复杂度的下界 Ω(m+m^{1/7}ε^{-2/7})，并提出匹配上界 Õ(m+m^{1/7}ε^{-2/7}) 的新算法，达到对数因子意义下的最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 lazy second-order oracle 设定下（每步查梯度、每 m 步查 Hessian），已有最优上界 Õ(m+m^{13/21}ε^{-2/7}) 与理论下界之间存在明显差距，作者希望刻画该模型真实复杂度并设计最优算法。

Method: 提出一种新颖的 block zero-chain 构造来证明迭代复杂度下界；并据此设计一个新的凸优化方法，以匹配下界。

Result: 下界：Ω(m+m^{1/7}ε^{-2/7})；新算法上界：Õ(m+m^{1/7}ε^{-2/7})，显著改进先前 Õ(m+m^{13/21}ε^{-2/7})。

Conclusion: 该模型复杂度被确定为 Õ(m+m^{1/7}ε^{-2/7})，上下界在对数因子意义下紧，达到最优。

Abstract: This paper studies the complexity of convex optimization using lazy second-order oracles (Doikov, Chayti, and Jaggi, ICML 2023), where an algorithm queries gradients every iteration and Hessians once per $m$ iterations. Under this setting, we show a lower bound of $Ω(m+ m^{1/7} ε^{-2/7})$ on the number of total iterations to find an $ε$-solution using a novel block zero-chain construction. Then we propose a novel method that achieves a new upper bound of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(m+ m^{1/7} ε^{-2/7})$, which significantly improves the prior one (Chen, Liu, Luo, and Zhang, COLT 2026) of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(m+ m^{13/21} ε^{-2/7})$ and is tight up to logarithmic factors.

</details>


### [324] [A Newton--Kleinman Iteration for Infinite-Dimensional Linear-Quadratic Optimal Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03242)
*Timo Reis*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出无穷维系统（含无界控制/观测）的Newton--Kleinman迭代，绕过代数Riccati方程，基于节点域Lur'e恒等式，保持稳定性并单调收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无穷维系统的经典代数Riccati方程可能无意义，无法作为迭代基础；而现实问题（边界控制/观测）常涉及无界算子，需新的迭代框架。

Method: 在系统节点域上线性化Lur'e恒等式；从任意镇定反馈出发构造迭代，通过基于预解式的归一化处理无界控制；采用低秩数值实现，基于移位系统求解与输入空间求逆。

Result: 迭代保持稳定性并给出单调递减代价算子序列；在有限代价可检测性和有限维输入空间下，迭代强收敛到最优值算子且与归一化参数无关；有限维时退化为经典Newton--Kleinman迭代。数值上验证于线性化圆柱尾流（边界牵引控制、无界观测）与阻尼线弹性问题。

Conclusion: 该框架将Newton--Kleinman迭代推广到无界控制/观测的无穷维LQ最优控制，兼具理论收敛保证与低秩可计算性，适用于边界控制的实际问题。

Abstract: We develop a Newton--Kleinman iteration for linear-quadratic optimal control of infinite-dimensional systems with possibly unbounded control and observation operators. In this setting, the classical algebraic Riccati equation need not be meaningful and therefore cannot serve as the basis of the iteration. We instead linearize a Lur'e identity formulated directly on the system-node domain. Starting from any stabilizing feedback, the resulting iteration is well defined, preserves stability, and yields a monotonically decreasing sequence of cost operators. A resolvent-based normalization makes the construction applicable to unbounded control. Under finite-cost detectability and for a finite-dimensional input space, the iterates converge strongly to the optimal value operator, independently of the fixed normalization parameter. In finite dimensions, the natural zero-state normalization recovers exactly the classical Newton--Kleinman iteration.
  The formulation leads to a low-rank numerical realization based on shifted system solves and inversions on the input space. We illustrate the method on a linearized cylinder wake with boundary traction control and unbounded observation, using one Newton--Kleinman update per adaptively refined spatial mesh, and on a damped linear elasticity problem with boundary traction control and boundary displacement observation.

</details>


### [325] [Wasserstein Contraction of Stochastic Systems on Manifolds: A Differential Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03264)
*Dongjun Wu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文将确定性收缩分析推广到连续时间随机系统，用均方微分构造随机变分动力学，通过沿初始条件曲线的L2稳定性积分得到概率律在Wasserstein距离下的收缩，并引入正交微分耦合拓展框架，应用于流形上的随机控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 确定性收缩分析可将全局收敛问题化为局部问题：若变分系统一致稳定，则原系统所有轨迹相互收敛。作者希望为连续时间随机系统建立类似理论，以概率律之间的Wasserstein距离度量收敛。

Method: 采用均方微分构造随机变分动力学；对其一致L2稳定性沿初始条件曲线积分，得到相关概率律的Wasserstein收缩。给出基于微分Lyapunov函数的判据，并在流形上导出内蕴Riemannian表述。利用噪声耦合作为设计自由度，提出正交微分耦合，超越同步耦合。

Result: 所得判据显式揭示状态空间曲率如何进入收缩机制，在正交标架情形下恢复经典Ricci曲率结构。应用于紧流形上的随机控制时，通过引入随机控制输入克服确定性全局镇定障碍。

Conclusion: 一个无法通过光滑时不变确定性反馈全局镇定的系统，可在W2意义下变为全局收缩，且其稳态分布可任意集中于指定目标平衡点。

Abstract: Contraction analysis of dynamical systems turns a global convergence problem into a local one. If the variational system is stable in a uniform sense, then all trajectories of the original system converge toward each other. This paper develops a stochastic analogue for continuous-time stochastic systems, where convergence is measured by Wasserstein distance between probability laws. The key step is to employ mean-square differentiation to construct stochastic variational dynamics. Its uniform $L_2$ stability can then be integrated along curves of initial conditions, yielding Wasserstein contraction of the associated probability laws. This yields criteria formulated in terms of differential Lyapunov functions, and on manifolds, it leads to intrinsic Riemannian formulations. A distinctive feature of the stochastic setting is that the coupling of the noises becomes a design freedom. To exploit this freedom, we introduce an orthogonal differential coupling that extends the framework beyond synchronous coupling. The resulting criterion explicitly exposes how the curvature of the state space enters the contraction mechanism and, in the orthonormal-frame case, recovers the classical Ricci-curvature structure. Finally, we apply the framework to stochastic control on a compact manifold. By introducing stochastic control input, we overcome a deterministic obstruction to global stabilization. That is, a system that cannot be globally stabilized through smooth time-invariant deterministic feedback is rendered globally contracting in $W_2$, and its steady state distribution can be made arbitrarily concentrated around a prescribed target equilibrium.

</details>


### [326] [Information Limits of Low-Rank Approximation Certification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03321)
*Kang Liu,Bohao Qu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文刻画低秩近似验证的认证成本：单候选时给出维度一致极小极大查询常数；多候选时复用验证响应，一批即可支持整条嵌套路径且查询预算不随检查次数增加，W 条路径下界为 √log(W+1) 且匹配最优；并对两类一致有效证书在分散谱上给出 N^{1/3} 与 N^{2/3} 的额外成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低秩近似往往需要额外的矩阵-向量乘积来验证其误差是否满足预设容差，这种"认证成本"此前缺乏精确刻画，尤其是验证响应能否被复用以降低多次检查的开销尚不清楚。

Method: 针对相对矩阵误差与均方输出误差两类准则，分别刻画单候选矩阵的认证成本；进一步研究当近似空间扩展时复用验证响应：假设候选族独立于验证构造，则一批查询可支持整条嵌套路径；对 W 条路径利用共享残差能量的集中不等式，并给出匹配下界证明最优性；最后在同一分散谱族上比较两类一致有效证书并对验证预算做族内优化。

Result: 单候选的精确维度一致极小极大查询常数在允许失败概率趋于零时被确定；复用场景下一批查询即可支持整条嵌套路径，查询预算不随检查次数增长，W 条路径仅多出 √log(W+1) 因子，且对固定内部误差目标与足够小间隔存在匹配下界；两类证书在分散谱族上优化后的验证与构造成本分别为 N^{1/3} 与 N^{2/3}（超出真实目标）。

Conclusion: 验证响应可被高效复用，使多次认证的查询开销几乎不随检查次数增长；本文给出的上下界刻画了该认证成本的最优阶，并揭示了不同证书规则族在验证与构造成本间的权衡。代码已开源。

Abstract: Low-rank approximation can require additional matrix--vector products to verify that its error meets a prescribed tolerance. We characterize this certification cost for both relative matrix error and mean-square output error. For a single approximation matrix candidate, we determine the exact dimension-uniform minimax query constant as the allowed failure probability vanishes. Our main result concerns reusing validation responses as the approximation space expands. For a candidate family constructed independently of validation, one batch supports an entire nested path without increasing the query budget with the number of checks. Across \(W\) paths, a concentration bound exploiting shared residual energy yields a \(\sqrt{\log(W+1)}\) dependence. A matching lower bound establishes its optimality for fixed interior error targets and sufficiently small separation gaps. Finally, we compare two uniformly valid certificates on the same dispersed-spectrum family. Optimizing the validation budget within each rule family yields costs of orders \(N^{1/3}\) and \(N^{2/3}\) for validation and construction beyond the true target. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Low-rank-approximation-1275/

</details>


### [327] [Optimal allocation in combat models with multiple battlefields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03336)
*Antonín Slavík,Vladimír Švígler*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究独立战场上固定兵力对已知敌方兵力分布的分配问题，用损失/生存函数代替具体作战方程，给出凸损失函数下的最优分配结构、NP难性、伪多项式算法及多种目标下的分配规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统兵力分配依赖特定作战方程（如Lanchester模型），缺乏通用性；本文希望在不假设具体作战方程的前提下，仅通过损失与生存函数刻画战场结果，建立更一般的分配理论。

Method: 将战场结果抽象为损失函数与生存函数；对凸敌方损失函数分析最优分配结构；对满足端点归一化的严格凸、严格增损失函数族证明NP难性；在总兵力与饱和阈值为整数时给出精确伪多项式算法；并推导最大化成功交战、最大化己方幸存者、最大化敌我损失比等目标下的分配规则。

Result: 证明凸损失函数下最优分配至多有一个战场部分饱和；证明每类满足端点归一化的严格凸增损失函数族上问题为NP难；给出整数情形下的精确伪多项式算法；得到多种目标下的分配规则；并应用于含Lanchester、游击战与混合模型的幂律损失函数族及隐式定义结果的模型。

Conclusion: 该框架在无需特定作战方程的情况下统一刻画兵力分配问题，揭示最优解的结构性质与计算复杂性，并为多种作战模型与目标提供可操作的分配规则。

Abstract: We study the allocation of a force of a fixed size across independent battlefields against a known distribution of opposing forces. Formulating battlefield outcomes through loss and survival functions allows us to establish allocation results without assuming a specific system of combat equations. For convex enemy loss functions, an optimal allocation exists with at most one partially saturated battlefield. We prove NP-hardness for every prescribed family of strictly convex, strictly increasing loss functions satisfying an endpoint normalization, and give an exact pseudopolynomial algorithm for the special case when the total force size and saturation thresholds are integers. We also derive allocation rules for maximizing successful engagements, maximizing own survivors, and maximizing the ratio of enemy losses to own losses. Applications include a power-law family containing the classical Lanchester, guerrilla, and mixed combat models, as well as models with implicitly defined outcomes.

</details>


### [328] [Compatible Bases and Actuator Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03353)
*Dawid E. Kędzierski,Piotr Krasoń*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究有序分块矩阵的约束基选择问题，刻画与尾空间旗相容的表示基，并应用于有限时域线性控制中的执行器调度，给出精确DFS及剪枝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有序分块矩阵的自然嵌套列空间结构需要一个"表示基"概念，但何时这些基与整个尾空间旗相容尚缺线性代数刻画；同时该结构在控制中的执行器调度（每个执行器恰用一次）与可达性剖面的保留问题上需要更精确的算法。

Method: 引入分块矩阵的表示基与尾空间旗相容性；证明相容性由内在分块配额 r_k=w_k-w_{k+1}（w_k 为第k个尾矩阵秩）完全刻画。将该结构对应到控制中的可达性矩阵 [A^{N-1}G|…|G]，把执行器调度视为表示系统，证明完整可达性剖面的保持等价于与尾空间旗相容。据此设计带未来秩剪枝准则的精确深度优先搜索。

Result: 在显式结构化族与固定搜索顺序下，基线搜索找到首个解前访问 3·2^m+m-2 个节点，而未来秩剪枝将其降至 3m+1；精确算术实验在所有测试实例上复现了这些公式。

Conclusion: 旗相容性由分块配额唯一决定，并在控制调度中自然出现；未来秩剪枝显著降低搜索复杂度，理论与实验一致。

Abstract: We study a constrained basis-selection problem for an ordered block matrix $B=[ B_1\mid\cdots\mid B_n ].$ The successive tail matrices determine a nested family of column spaces, and we consider bases of representatives which are compatible with this induced flag. Our main linear-algebraic result shows that, among bases of representatives, compatibility with the entire flag is characterized by the intrinsic block quotas $r_k=w_k-w_{k+1}$, where $w_k$ is the rank of the $k$-th tail matrix.
  We then show that the same structure arises naturally in finite-horizon linear control. For the reachability matrix $[A^{N-1}G\mid \cdots\mid G]$, requiring every actuator to be used exactly once turns an actuator schedule into a representative system. Preservation of the complete reachability profile is then equivalent to compatibility with the tail-space flag.
  This correspondence leads to an exact depth-first search with a future-rank pruning criterion. For an explicit structured family and a fixed search ordering, the baseline search visits $3\cdot2^m+m-2$ nodes before the first solution, whereas future-rank pruning reduces this number to $3m+1$. Exact-arithmetic experiments reproduce these formulas for all tested instances.

</details>


### [329] [Convex geometry of diffusion laws and gradient flows for stochastic control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03487)
*Yupeng Bai,Louis-Pierre Chaintron,Zhenjie Ren,Songbo Wang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 该文研究了路径空间上受控扩散分布的梯度型动力学，借助一致凸运行代价诱导的Bregman几何构造隐式近端格式与镜像流，并分析其收敛性、有限粒子近似及Markov情形下的反馈控制收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 弱随机控制的目标关于漂移一般非凸，直接优化困难，因此需要寻找合适的几何结构（如路径分布的严格凸性）来建立可分析的梯度动力学框架。

Method: 利用一致凸运行代价诱导路径分布上的严格凸泛函与Bregman几何；构造隐式近端格式并证明适定性与向连续时间镜像流的收敛；在特定条件下得到仿射熵坐标与Newton流；用二次BSDE的BMO估计构造自然梯度流；分析交互有限粒子近似；在Markov情形使用反射耦合。

Result: 证明近端格式的适定性与收敛；在镜像代价等于运行代价且势线性时获得变分构造的Newton流、一致稳定性与指数收敛；一般情形下构造全局自然梯度流并给出定量收敛与一阶离散误差；有限粒子近似指数收敛到粒子最优，且与平均场最优的归一化差异为O(1/N)；Markov情形下反馈控制具有一致空间正则性与指数收敛，包括非二次状态依赖Hamiltonian。

Conclusion: 该工作为弱随机控制提供了一套基于路径分布凸性与Bregman几何的梯度型动力学理论，涵盖连续时间流、离散格式、粒子近似及Markov反馈控制的收敛性保证。

Abstract: We study gradient-type dynamics for weak stochastic control through the laws of controlled diffusions on path space. Although the objective is generally nonconvex in the drift, a uniformly convex running cost induces a strictly convex functional of the corresponding path law and hence a natural Bregman geometry. We construct the associated implicit proximal scheme and prove its well-posedness and convergence to a continuous-time mirror flow. When the mirror cost coincides with the running cost and the law-dependent potential is linear, the flow becomes affine in centered entropy coordinates. This yields a variational construction of the resulting Newton flow, uniform stability estimates, and exponential convergence to the optimizer. For a general uniformly convex mirror cost and a nonlinear convex potential of the law, we construct the natural-gradient flow globally in learning time using BMO estimates for quadratic BSDEs, and establish quantitative convergence and a first-order discretization error. We further analyze interacting finite-particle approximations, proving exponential convergence to the finite-particle optimum and an O(1/N) normalized discrepancy from the mean-field optimum. In the Markovian setting, reflection coupling yields uniform spatial regularity and exponential convergence of the feedback controls on Rd, including for nonquadratic state-dependent Hamiltonians.

</details>


### [330] [Optimality of delayed reward attainment under uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03506)
*Chuwei Wang,Alexander Vladimirsky,Anastasia Bizyaeva*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 将"不确定奖励下的具身决策"建模为带两个终端选项的确定性最优控制问题，研究奖励学习与状态演化的交互，发现延迟获取奖励常为最优，并给出可提前缩短规划期的充分条件及主动传感策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身决策（如动物觅食、机器人选目标）中，移动既影响信息质量又带来行动成本，需要在"获取更多信息"与"延迟决策的代价"间权衡，而奖励学习与状态演化的交互机制尚不清晰。

Method: 把问题形式化为确定性最优控制问题：两个终端选项，一个奖励已知，另一个通过带噪观测逐步学习；分析奖励学习与状态演化的交互，并推导特定问题下可先验缩短规划期的充分条件；在观测质量依赖状态时，分析控制器是否应主动将状态演化至更具信息量的位置。

Result: 在多种系统中延迟获取奖励往往是最优的，尤其当两个选项初始难以区分且等待成本较低时；对一类子问题给出了保证后续观测不再影响值函数的充分条件；当观测质量依赖状态时，控制器常应策略性地先移动到信息更丰富的位置再决策。

Conclusion: 延迟决策与主动传感是具身不确定性决策中的普遍最优策略，与生物及工程系统中观察到的行为一致；所给充分条件可用于提前截断规划期，降低计算负担。

Abstract: Decision making under uncertainty requires balancing the value of additional information against the cost of delaying the decision until that information becomes available. This challenge is especially prevalent for embodied decisions such as those faced by animals moving between food sources and robots selecting navigation targets, where movement through space shapes both the quality of information and the cost of acting. We consider a version of this problem, where the decision is on choosing among rewards of uncertain value, and those rewards can only be attained through changing the decision maker's state sufficiently. Our focus is on interactions between reward learning and state evolution, restated as a deterministic optimal control problem with two terminal alternatives, one with a known reward and the other learned gradually through noisy observations. We demonstrate that delayed reward attainment is often optimal in a variety of systems, especially so when the alternatives are initially difficult to distinguish and the cost of waiting is relatively low. For a subset of problems, we also derive sufficient conditions that allow shortening the planning horizon a priori, guaranteeing that further observations would not affect the value function. Finally, when observation quality depends on the state, we show that it is often optimal for a controller to evolve the state strategically toward more informative sensing locations before making a decision, in line with the behavior broadly observed in biological and engineered systems.

</details>


### [331] [Grid Theory and Polynomiality in Dynamic Lot-Sizing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03559)
*El-Mehdi Mehiri,Nabil Absi,Elodie Suzanne*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出Grid Theory框架，从累积产量与生产上下界的加性结构出发，揭示了动态批量问题多项式可解的本质机制：加性维度有界时，最优累积产量轨迹可限制在多项式可构造的网格上，并给出多项式时间DP算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为何某些动态批量问题是多项式可解的，其结构根源尚未被清晰刻画。传统观点常归因于资源取值个数少，但本文希望找到更本质的充分条件。

Method: 提出基于累积产量与生产边界加性结构的Grid Theory。证明在每个再生区间内，最优极值解中至多有一个产量不在边界上，从而诱导加性网格，并由主网格定理限制最优累积产量轨迹。引入"加性维度"刻画边界和的低维表示，进而构造多项式规模的网格包络与基于网格的动态规划算法。框架可扩展至可分离凹成本。

Result: 加性维度有界时，网格包络可多项式构造，存在多项式时间网格DP算法。框架证明多类问题多项式可解：常容量、最小订购量、固定容量层数、固定次数多项式容量、周期容量、分段多项式容量。即使不同容量值个数随规划期增长，多项式性仍可能成立。

Conclusion: Grid Theory表明，多项式可解性的充分机制是加性结构而非不同资源取值的数量，为动态批量问题的复杂性分类提供了新的结构视角。

Abstract: Why are some dynamic lot-sizing problems polynomial? We address this question by introducing Grid Theory, a structural framework based on cumulative production and the additive structure of production bounds. For a general single-item dynamic lot-sizing model with lower and upper production bounds, there exists an optimal extreme solution in which, within each regeneration interval, all but at most one production quantity lie on a boundary value. This induces additive grids, and the Main Grid Theorem establishes that an optimal cumulative production trajectory can be restricted to these discrete sets. Although the resulting grids may be exponentially large, we introduce the notion of additive dimension to capture production-bound profiles whose boundary sums admit a low-dimensional representation. We show that bounded additive dimension yields a polynomially constructible grid envelope and a polynomial time grid-based dynamic programming algorithm. The framework extends to separable concave costs and establishes polynomial solvability of several families, including constant capacities, minimum order quantities, a fixed number of capacity levels, fixed-degree polynomial capacities, periodic capacities, and piecewise polynomial capacities. In particular, polynomiality may hold even when the number of distinct capacity values grows with the planning horizon. Grid Theory thus identifies additive structure, rather than the number of distinct resource values, as a sufficient mechanism for polynomial solvability.

</details>

### [333] [Closing the Accuracy Gap in Stochastic First-Order Bilevel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03633)
*Haihan Zhang,Wendao Wu,Chenheng Zhang,Yanyi Li,Chunyuan Zheng,Cong Fang,Haoxuan Li,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文刻画了光滑非凸-强凸双层优化在随机一阶oracle下的最优精度依赖，证明了匹配现有上界的Ω(ε^{-6})下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双层优化的随机一阶方法已有上界，但缺少与之匹配的下界，尤其缺乏对精度指数及条件数依赖是否为最优的严格刻画。

Method: 在全局Lipschitz梯度、下层梯度有界、下层Hessian块Lipschitz等假设下，构造嵌入序列困难目标的精确下层响应，并结合多尺度分解限制各新方向携带的梯度信号，对任意随机自适应算法建立下界；同时提出frozen-linear-tilt估计器分析其偏差与下层Hessian变化的关系。

Result: 证明Ω(Lκ²Δε^{-2}+L³χ²κ⁸σ_g²Δε^{-6})下界，匹配ε^{-6}指数；在ρ=Θ(L)时主随机项条件数依赖为κ^{10}，接近可达到的κ^{11}；估计器偏差正比于下层Hessian变化，在曲率受控与小间隙情形达到匹配主速率。

Conclusion: 该下界在完整欧氏空间对任意随机自适应算法成立，确立了双层优化的最优精度指数，并显式揭示条件数与Hessian变化的结构依赖。

Abstract: We characterize the optimal accuracy dependence for smooth nonconvex--strongly-convex bilevel optimization with stochastic first-order oracles. For globally unbiased fresh-gradient observations with bounded variance, we prove an $Ω(ε^{-6})$ lower bound matching the accuracy exponent of existing upper bounds. We consider globally Lipschitz gradients, a bounded upper gradient in the lower variable, and Lipschitz lower Hessian blocks, with target $\mathbb{E}|\nabla F(\widehat{x})|\leε$. Let $L$ be the common first-order scale, $μ$ the lower strong-convexity modulus, $ρ$ the lower Hessian-variation budget, $κ=L/μ$, and $χ=1+ρ/μ$. For $ρ\gtrsimμ$, $χ\lesssimκ$, sufficiently high accuracy, and sufficiently large dimension, we establish $Ω\left(Lκ^2Δε^{-2}+L^3χ^2κ^8σ_g^2Δε^{-6}\right)$, where $Δ$ is the initial gap budget and $σ_g^2$ is the lower-gradient variance budget. The bound holds over full Euclidean spaces against arbitrary randomized adaptive algorithms, even when every sample is the gradient of a scalar function. In the common-scale regime $ρ=Θ(L)$, the leading stochastic term has condition-number dependence $κ^{10}$, compared with the achievable $κ^{11}$ dependence. The proof embeds a sequential hard objective into an exact lower response while preserving global regularity and finite gap. A multiscale decomposition limits the gradient signal carrying each new direction, yielding the required sample complexity. We complement this lower bound with a frozen-linear-tilt estimator whose bias is proportional to lower Hessian variation. Its analysis makes this structural dependence explicit and yields matching leading rates in the specified curvature-controlled and small-gap regimes.

</details>


### [334] [The Minimax Cost of Smoothness in Fully First-Order Stochastic Bilevel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03638)
*Wendao Wu,Haihan Zhang,Chenheng Zhang,Yanyi Li,Chunyuan Zheng,Cong Fang,Haoxuan Li,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文刻画了非凸-强凸随机双层优化中寻找期望超梯度范数≤ε问题的样本复杂度：证明F²SA-p的上下界Θ_p(ε^{-4-2/p})，并在高阶光滑预算L_j=MΛ^j(j!)β下给出固定预算极小极大复杂度，表明定量光滑性带来精确收益，而仅定性解析性仍可导致Θ(ε^{-6})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: F²SA-p已取得上界Õ(pε^{-4-2/p})，但指数4+2/p的必要性未决；同时光滑性质量对样本复杂度的影响尚不清晰。

Method: 在全局无偏、有限方差的一阶样本与固定非退化正则预算下，建立匹配的上下界；下界适用于固定样本预算的任意随机算法，允许维度随精度增长并保持全局无偏与各阶下变量光滑约束。进一步在L_j=MΛ^j(j!)β下刻画极小极大固定预算复杂度，并设计带加权独立批次的梯度差分方法。

Result: 证明Θ_p(ε^{-4-2/p})匹配上下界；在L_j=MΛ^j(j!)β下给出Q_{p,β}^*(ε)=Θ(ε^{-4}[inf_{1≤r≤p} r^β ε^{-1/r}]^2)；无穷阶时β=0为Θ(ε^{-4})，β=1为Θ(ε^{-4}log^2(1/ε))；所提方法统一达到这些界。

Conclusion: 定量光滑性可换来精确的样本复杂度增益；仅依赖定性解析性仍容许Θ(ε^{-6})复杂度，说明光滑阶数的量化信息至关重要。

Abstract: We study the sample complexity of finding a point with expected hypergradient norm at most $ε>0$ in nonconvex--strongly-convex stochastic bilevel optimization using fresh, globally unbiased first-order samples with bounded variance. For lower-variable smoothness order $p\ge1$, F$^2$SA-$p$ achieves $\widetilde O(pε^{-4-2/p})$ (Chen et al., 2026), but necessity of the exponent $4+2/p$ was open. We prove matching upper and lower bounds $Θ_p(ε^{-4-2/p})$ under fixed nondegenerate regularity budgets, with constants allowed to depend on $p$. The lower bound holds for unrestricted randomized algorithms under a fixed sample budget, allows dimension to grow with accuracy, and preserves global unbiasedness and all prescribed lower-variable smoothness bounds, even with a scalar lower variable and exact upper gradients. We further characterize the minimax fixed-budget complexity under $L_j=MΛ^j(j!)^β$ for $j\ge3$: $Q_{p,β}^*(ε)=Θ\left(ε^{-4}\left[\inf_{1\le r\le p,,r\in\mathbb N} r^βε^{-1/r}\right]^2\right)$, for $p\in\mathbb N\cup{\infty}$, with constants independent of $p$. At infinite order, this gives $Θ(ε^{-4})$ for $β=0$ and $Θ(ε^{-4}\log^2(1/ε))$ for $β=1$. A gradient-difference method with weighted independent batches attains these bounds uniformly in order.
